title: The Power of Love
lyrics:
[00:00.000] 作词 : Jennifer Rush
[00:01.000] 作曲 : Jennifer Rush
[00:03.876]The whispers in the morning
[00:10.632]of lovers sleeping tight
[00:17.879]are rolling by like thunder now
[00:24.123]As I look in your eyes
[00:30.882]I hold on to your body
[00:37.383]and feel each move you make
[00:44.384]your voice is warm and tender
[00:48.632]a love that I could not forsake
[00:57.874]Cause I'm your lady
[01:04.631]and you are my man
[01:11.131]Whenever you reach for me
[01:17.878]I'll do all that i can
[01:25.378]lost is how i'm feeling
[01:32.135]lying in your arms
[01:38.624]when the world outside's too much to take
[01:45.382]that all ends when i'm with you
[01:51.884]Even though there may be times
[01:58.872]it seems I'm far away
[02:05.629]Never wonder where I am
[02:14.083]cause I am always by your side
[02:18.830]Cause I'm your lady
[02:25.830]and you are my man
[02:32.578]Whenever you reach for me
[02:39.334]I'll do all that I can
[02:45.835]We're heading for something
[02:52.583]somewhere I've never been
[03:00.774]Sometimes I am frightened
[03:02.771]but I'm ready to learn
[03:06.023]of the power of love
[03:16.519]The sound of your heart beating
[03:23.021]made it clear suddenly
[03:30.021]The feeling that I can't go on
[03:36.776]is light years away
[03:47.029]Cause I'm your lady
[03:53.519]and you are my man
[04:00.275]Whenever you reach for me
[04:07.022]I'm gonna do all that i can
[04:13.777]We're heading for something
[04:21.974]somewhere I've never been
[04:27.223]Sometimes I am frightened
[04:29.973]but I'm ready to learn
[04:34.224]of the power of love
[04:47.968]The power of love
[05:01.970]The power of love
